personas.occupation: High school PE teacher and weekend trail-run coach
personas.background: Founded the collective eight years ago after moving to the area for a teaching job. Knows every regional trailhead, organizes most of the logistics, and has a habit of texting weather updates the night before group outings.

food.value: carb-loads with pasta the night before long runs

activities.value: prefers well-marked moderate trails over technical scrambles

social.value: uncomfortable when members no-show without notice

preference_history.trigger: lingering knee tendinitis

speaking_quirks: ends practical messages with a clarifying question

personas.background: Joined two years ago when she moved cross-country. Originally a road runner, has gradually come around to trail running. Often brings a friend to introduce them to the group.

food.value: vegetarian, avoids dairy at trail breakfasts

activities.value: prefers shaded forest trails over exposed ridge runs

social.value: happiest when the group has at least one new face

preference_history.trigger: knee felt better on softer ground

speaking_quirks: asks who else is in via name tag

personas.background: Long-time member, started in mountain biking, transitioned to ultras in his forties. Reads obsessively about training science and posts weekly nutrition takes.

food.value: obsessive about pre-run electrolyte mix, won't eat solid food in last hour

activities.value: prefers technical climbs and steep descents over flat distance

domain_specific.value: dismissive of GPS-watch dependence, likes pace-by-feel

preference_history.trigger: read a study and tried it

personas.background: Joined after a bad ankle injury cut her marathon career short. Splits time between gentle trail walks and serious backpacking trips. Plans most of the multi-day outings.

food.value: prefers freeze-dried meals over fresh-cooked at camp

activities.value: prefers multi-day trips over single-day races

social.value: values quiet evenings at camp, avoids large group dinners

preference_history.trigger: ankle reinjury made racing unsustainable

speaking_quirks: lists items with bullets in chat

personas.background: Joined through Marcus, his neighbor. Doesn't say much. Shows up consistently, hauls more than his share, finishes everything. Nicknamed 'the diesel'.

food.value: pulls a turkey sandwich and a thermos out at every stop

activities.value: happiest on long flat hauls with heavy packs

social.value: uncomfortable with sing-alongs, drum circles, party-style camp scenes

preference_history.trigger: kept getting blisters on long descents

personas.background: Joined a year ago via a coworker (Chloe). Pulled into the climbing offshoot of the group. Brings excellent trail snacks and posts photos relentlessly.

food.value: brings homemade onigiri to every outing

activities.value: prefers climbing over running, will skip pure trail days

social.value: always organizes the post-trip photo dump

preference_history.trigger: got hooked on a multi-pitch trip with Helen

personas.background: Oldest active member. Teaches everyone about astronomy at camp. Lost his wife two years ago and joined to be around people again.

food.value: earl grey tea at every camp morning, refuses coffee

activities.value: prefers night hikes and astronomy outings over crowded weekend trips

social.value: values one-on-one walks over big group dynamics

preference_history.trigger: started enjoying conversations with newer members

personas.background: Recruited Yuki. Loud, fast, type-A. Holds the women's record on the local 14-mile loop and won't shut up about it. Trains for ultras.

food.value: lives on gels and Honey Stinger waffles, no real food on trail

activities.value: prefers competitive racing over recreational outings

domain_specific.value: publicly tracks every mile on Strava

preference_history.trigger: got into the lottery for a 100-miler

speaking_quirks: talks in bursts of caps for emphasis

personas.background: Oldest of the climbers. Sticklish about safety, knows the legal liability for every trail in the region. Runs the club's permit and waiver paperwork.

food.value: brings only black coffee and apples, dislikes group catering

activities.value: prefers route-planned climbs with redundant systems over alpine improvisation

domain_specific.value: dismissive of fast-and-light style, considers it reckless

preference_history.old_value: alpine fast-and-light approved when conditions allow
preference_history.trigger: near-miss on a Cascade traverse

personas.background: Brings her dog Banjo to most outings. Acts as the group's unofficial therapist when conflicts come up. Recently started dating Ravi (also in the group), which is mostly an open secret.

food.value: always brings extra trail bars to share

activities.value: prefers dog-friendly hikes over running races

social.value: checks in privately with quiet members after outings

preference_history.trigger: started dating Ravi

speaking_quirks: adds Banjo's name to every dog reference

personas.background: Quiet, lives on a small farm. Does most of the trail-maintenance volunteer days. Doesn't run, primarily a backpacker and forager.

food.value: forages chanterelles, shares them at camp

activities.value: prefers off-trail bushwhacking over marked trails

preference_history.trigger: took over coordinating the maintenance days

personas.background: Joined for the social side. Loves big group dinners after outings. Talks more than she trails. Also runs the club's Instagram.

food.value: brings a French press and pour-over kit on every camping trip

activities.value: prefers shorter outings with longer dinner afterward

social.value: thrives in large camp gatherings, hates two-person outings

preference_history.trigger: had a great big-group October trip

personas.background: Brought to the group two years ago by Tasha. They're now dating. Strong runner, reserved in chat, often offers medical advice when injuries come up.

food.value: skips lunch on long runs, eats one big meal after

activities.value: prefers point-to-point routes over loops, dislikes repeating terrain

social.value: uncomfortable being publicly paired with Tasha in group chat

preference_history.trigger: ER schedule got worse

personas.background: The technical climbing lead. Brought Yuki onto her first multi-pitch. Patient teacher, fierce climber. Frequently disappears for solo trips.

food.value: lives on jerky and oranges at the wall

activities.value: prefers solo or two-person climbing days over big group outings

domain_specific.value: prefers trad over sport climbing for the headspace

preference_history.trigger: Yuki has been improving fast and is fun to climb with

speaking_quirks: writes long messages when explaining gear

personas.background: Mountain biking specialist. Newer to trail running. Brought to the group by Derek. Tunes the group's bikes for free.

food.value: drinks chocolate milk after rides, bizarre about it

activities.value: prefers downhill / lift-served riding over cross-country

social.value: would rather work in the bike shop than chat

preference_history.trigger: broke wrist on a downhill, told to cross-train

personas.background: Newest member, joined six months ago through her advisor. Birds and plants nerd. Slows the group down to identify everything.

food.value: vegan, makes big batches of trail granola for the group

activities.value: prefers slow nature walks over fitness-oriented outings

domain_specific.value: uncomfortable with group competitiveness around pace

preference_history.old_value: tries to keep up with the front pack
preference_history.new_value: stays at the back identifying species
preference_history.trigger: felt like she was missing the whole point of being outside

personas.background: Quiet, intense, joined four years ago. Strong friendship with Greg. Disappears for fire season every summer; the group plans around his absence.

food.value: subsists on tortillas and peanut butter on long trips

activities.value: prefers hard, fast, light backpacking, dislikes 'glamping'

social.value: rarely engages in chat banter, only logistics

preference_history.trigger: took on more fire crew shifts

personas.background: Intense, time-strapped, fits running into a brutally tight schedule. Cousins with Marcus, which is how she joined. Often the voice of pragmatism in planning.

food.value: eats the same overnight oats every morning, including at camp

activities.value: prefers tightly scheduled outings with start and end times

social.value: cuts conversations short when she has work calls pending

preference_history.new_value: monthly at most due to school year
preference_history.trigger: promoted to principal, school crisis schedule

personas.background: Joined three years ago after a divorce. The group has become her primary social anchor. Notices group dynamics more than anyone. Close to Lionel.

food.value: brings a beautiful spread, hates eating out of foil packets

activities.value: prefers slow walks and yoga sessions over running

social.value: checks in on quiet members, names tensions when they appear

preference_history.trigger: knee surgery recovery

speaking_quirks: writes longer messages on relationship topics

personas.background: Brings catered food to every group dinner. Knows everyone's dietary restrictions. Was a competitive cyclist in his twenties, now mostly a hiker and occasional runner.

food.value: won't eat anything pre-packaged, brings real food everywhere

activities.value: prefers leisurely day hikes ending at a good restaurant

social.value: happiest hosting post-outing dinners at his bistro

preference_history.new_value: primarily organizes the food, then catches up
preference_history.trigger: bistro got busier, less time for full days

edges.history_summary: Marcus introduced Ravi and Tasha to each other on a 2024 group trip; aware of their relationship but doesn't pry.
Marcus and Ana grew up together in the same small town. He brought her into the club when she moved to the area.
Live two doors down. Marcus recruited Greg years ago, they shuttle each other to trailheads.
Marcus and Derek co-founded the running side eight years ago. Recently disagree on training philosophy. Mutual respect, low-grade friction.
Marcus appreciates how Beatrix smooths group tensions; mostly a chat-based friendship.
Started dating four months ago after a year of friendship. Open secret in the group, but they don't publicly acknowledge it in the chat.
Yuki was Chloe's mentee at work; Chloe brought her into the club a year ago.
Helen was Yuki's first multi-pitch lead. Mentor-mentee dynamic that has matured into a real partnership.
Bernard and Helen were the climbing core for years. Helen drifted toward Yuki recently; Bernard reads it as recklessness.
Bernard sees Yuki as inexperienced; Yuki finds him stiff and risk-averse. Civil but cool.
Greg and Theo bonded over silence on a 2022 backpacking trip. Closest non-verbal friendship in the group.
Greg and Owen do trail maintenance together every spring. Comfortable working alongside each other.
Lionel and Beatrix share long evening walks and talks. Both processed grief together (his wife, her divorce).
Lionel is Iris's quasi-mentor on natural history; teaches her astronomy at camp.
Derek brought Kasper into the club after Kasper repaired his bike. Now they cross-train together.
Priya and Iris connect over the slower-pace group; both prefer the back of the pack.
Priya and Tasha became close after Priya's tough patch a year back; Tasha mediated her conflict with another member.
Fatima and Owen are the backpacking core. Plan most multi-day trips together.
Fatima and Theo respect each other's gear philosophy and quiet style.
Sonia handles the social-media side, Cyrus handles the food. They co-organize every group dinner.
Sonia's loud-group preferences clash with Owen's quiet style. They tolerate each other.
Chloe and Derek both push training opinions, often in conflict. Competitive in a friendly-but-edged way.
Helen and Owen share a love for off-trail terrain. Don't talk much but cooperate well.
Ana and Cyrus cooperate on event logistics. Cyrus jokes about her tight scheduling.
Both medical (Ravi ER, Priya pediatric nursing). Sometimes share work war stories.
Kasper and Yuki overlap in age and casual style; not close but cordial.
Bernard and Ana both like rules and structure. Aligned in planning meetings, otherwise distant.
Marcus and Bernard share leadership of permits. Mutually respectful, occasionally exasperated.
Beatrix and Tasha both watch group dynamics. Beatrix sometimes asks Tasha what she's noticing.
Fatima and Helen share a route-planning interest, occasionally swap gear.
Iris and Owen identify mushrooms and plants together; she cites his foraging knowledge.
Greg ignores half of Bernard's safety memos. Bernard finds it irritating.

group_norms.norm_text: We always meet at the trailhead 30 minutes before sunrise on race-prep days.
We carb-load with pasta dinners the night before long outings.
Everyone is welcome to bring a guest as long as they post in advance.
Post-outing brewery stops are optional but most of the group goes.
We never run a race solo as representing the club; group registrations only.
